http/internal/websocket_reading#

Reading WebSocket frames from a stream, one at a time.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Reading WebSocket frames from a stream, one at a time.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object WebSocketFrameReading#

object WebSocketFrameReading

Memoized one-frame consumption, borrowed input and one supervised child per physical read. No completed-read history survives to the next operation.

WebSocketFrameReading.WebSocketFrameReading#

WebSocketFrameReading(origin is AsyncReading, masked is bool, maximum is int)

Reads from origin, expecting masking or not, payloads up to maximum bytes.

WebSocketFrameReading.frame#

async frame() is WebSocketFrame

The frame, unmasked; WebSocketFailure for an invalid one.
